# Race-detector shards of the CI `race` job (`go test -race`): packages
# under a "[N]" header, one per line, as `./` paths. The shard holding "*"
# runs every package of `go list ./...` that no other shard names, so a
# package can never be left out; a package named twice, or one that does
# not exist, fails the job (race-shard.py). Balanced by the race run times
# of the packages (the slowest single package bounds a shard).
[1]
./internal/languages/golang
./internal/tsparse
./internal/index
[2]
./internal/resolver
./internal/languages/typescript
[3]
*
